comments.author: Xiao Wei
comments.body: I get a lot of these in Songsunri dungeon on mid floors 4 and 5.

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
This is a land battle item that temporary increase your attack- and defense power in land by 20 % from its base value. The duration is roughly 40 ~ 45 seconds which is can be helpful in making fast kills.

CAUTION: If you use any other item or tech that gives a different buff state (total evasion, berserk etc.) while under this one... then it will be negated. Same happens if doing the opposite, therefore be careful.
